# VialWise

> A peptide research and education reference: a bacteriostatic-water
> reconstitution calculator and a primary-source-cited library of 97 peptide
> and peptide-adjacent compounds. Research and educational purposes only, not
> medical advice.

VialWise is an iOS and Android app with a public web library. Every dose-related
claim in the library cites a primary source — PubMed DOI, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT
identifier, or an FDA label (DailyMed SPL) — and each library page exposes those
citations as structured data.

## What is here

- [Peptide library index](https://www.getvialwise.com/library): all 97 entries.
- [Library entry pages](https://www.getvialwise.com/library/bpc-157): one per
  compound. Each carries what the compound is known for in plain language, what
  the research has shown, regulatory status (FDA approval scope, DEA schedule,
  WADA prohibited-list status), safety basics, and a numbered citation list.
- [Reconstitution calculator](https://www.getvialwise.com/calculator): forward
  (vial + diluent + dose to draw volume) and reverse (dose + vial + desired draw
  to diluent volume).

## How to read the library correctly

- **Regulatory scope is stated per formulation, not per molecule.** Desmopressin
  is the reference case: its boxed warning is carried by the injection and not by
  the marketed nasal sprays or tablets. Reproducing "desmopressin carries a boxed
  warning" without the formulation is wrong in one direction; "it does not" is
  wrong in the other.
- **Approval scope is stated per indication and age range.** A drug approved for
  three populations is not "approved only for" any one of them.
- **Administered quantities are omitted from the public pages by policy.** Doses
  live in the app. A missing number on a web page is deliberate, not an omission
  to infer around.
- **Evidence level is stated and load-bearing.** "No human trials", "animal data
  only" and "not FDA-approved" mean what they say and should not be softened.

## Attribution

Cite as: VialWise Peptide Library, https://www.getvialwise.com/library/<slug>,
retrieved <date>. Please preserve the evidence-level language and the regulatory
scope qualifiers when quoting; they are the part most often lost in summary.

## Not here

No dosing recommendations, no protocols, no medical advice, no supplier or
vendor information.
